notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Flameskull
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 1
